Add-artist creates row with select-artist-status-1 dropdown; setting any artist to 'Freelance' enables fee input, all-Tim disables it (verified). Deadline colors: with current data on Mei 2026, no orders fall in <3d/<5d windows (closest is 7d, 'done' status muted) so 0 rose/0 amber cells observed — logic exists in Orders.jsx:18-26 and is correct.

minor.issue: Endpoint uses blocking 'requests' library inside an async coroutine — same pattern as reminder_loop. Low frequency, acceptable, but consider httpx.AsyncClient for consistency.

No idempotency guard — re-POSTing the same invoice_no creates a duplicate row. Front-end relies on counter being read fresh; under concurrent prints there's a benign race. Consider unique index on (klien, invoice_no) or (klien, seq).

issues: Total Equity stat card does NOT have data-testid='stat-total-value' (per iter3 spec). The card renders correctly but its testid is missing/different — only stat-total-project / stat-done / stat-net / stat-unpaid expose testids. Add data-testid='stat-total-value' (and -value child) for testability parity. Note: the iter3 report previously claimed stat-total-value existed; this iter shows the testid is currently absent.

Row body click does NOT open the edit modal — only the pencil/edit icon in 'Aksi' column does. This is a deliberate UX choice (avoids accidental edits during text-selection) but tests should target [data-testid='edit-btn-<id>'] instead of [data-testid^='order-row-'].

action_items: Add data-testid='stat-total-value' (and stat-total-value-value child) to the Total Equity card in Dashboard.jsx for testability parity with the rest of the stat cards.
Optional: add unique compound index on db.invoices(klien, seq) to make seq generation safe under concurrency (current count_documents+insert is non-atomic).
Optional: switch send_telegram + per-order notify to httpx.AsyncClient (currently blocks the event loop briefly on each notify click).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/invoices: count_documents + insert is non-atomic — concurrent prints for same klien can produce duplicate seq values. Use findOneAndUpdate on a counters collection or unique index + retry.
server.py /api/orders/{id}/notify uses blocking 'requests' inside async; under heavy notify-button mashing this can starve the event loop briefly. Acceptable now (single-admin) but flag.
server.py reminder_loop: same blocking-request issue. Acceptable at 10-min cadence.

Invoice.jsx handlePrint POSTs to /api/invoices unconditionally on each print — re-printing the same logical invoice will create another DB row and bump seq. Consider tracking 'this invoice has been recorded' in component state and PATCHing instead of POSTing on subsequent prints.

OrderModal Telegram notify: handleNotif is fire-and-forget; no toast on success/failure beyond the disabled state. Consider surfacing the response via toast — currently the user has no feedback if the 400 'Telegram belum dikonfigurasi' is returned.
